name: iam:PassRole + ec2:RunInstances
description: Launch an EC2 instance with a privileged role attached, execute code via user-data scripts
author: Seth Art

admin: IAM instance profile with desired permissions
VPC with subnet for instance placement

options.name: INSTANCE_PROFILE
options.description: Target IAM instance profile name or ARN to pass to EC2 instance

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for EC2 instance deployment

options.name: AMI_ID
options.description: AMI ID for EC2 instance (will auto-detect Amazon Linux 2023 if not specified)

options.name: SUBNET_ID
options.description: Subnet ID for instance placement (will use default VPC if not specified)

options.name: INSTANCE_NAME
options.description: Name tag for the EC2 instance

options.name: WAIT_FOR_READY
options.description: Wait for instance to reach running state

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: backdoor/create-access-key
payloads.description: Create access keys for an existing IAM user via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: backdoor/create-role
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with administrator privileges and custom trust policy via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: backdoor/create-user
payloads.description: Create an IAM user with administrator privileges and optional console/programmatic access via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: backdoor/update-role-trust
payloads.description: Append a trust policy statement to an existing IAM role via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: exfil/https
payloads.description: Exfiltrate instance role credentials to an attacker-controlled HTTPS endpoint via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: exfil/s3
payloads.description: Exfiltrate EC2 instance role credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket via user-data

payloads.name: revshell/tls
payloads.description: Establish a TLS-encrypted reverse shell via EC2 user-data
